document.title: Configure ripgrep for Cursor eval agents
document.summary: Cursor eval runs set CURSOR_RIPGREP_PATH to the SDK platform package rg before Agent.create, so ignore scans can start ripgrep.
document.why: Eval runs print Ripgrep path not configured from the Cursor SDK. [The request](source:s1) asks to set that path at startup.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 27
sources.gist: Remove the Cursor SDK ripgrep error during eval by configuring the rg path at startup.

commits.subject: Point Cursor eval agents at the bundled ripgrep
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The SDK does not export configureRipgrepPath. On local startup it
reads an absolute CURSOR_RIPGREP_PATH and calls that function. pnpm
does not put the platform package rg where the SDK searches, and
GitHub runners have no rg on PATH, so ignore scans log the error.
